question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

Rahul was sharing some of his childhood stories and they were __hysterical__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Funny.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Hysterical: Something which causes unrestrained laughter; very funny. (हास्यजनक)

 
 
• For example- *Oh, that joke is hysterical!*
 
 
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words in the options section.
 
 
• Emotional: Having feelings that are easily excited and openly displayed. (भावनात्मक)
 
• Dangerous: Able or likely to cause harm or injury. (खतरनाक)
 
• Funny: Causing laughter or amusement; humorous. (मज़ेदार)
 
 
• For example- *I have found Charlie Chaplin to be very funny.*
 
 
 
• Scary: Frightening; causing fear. (भयानक)
 
 
 
• From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate synonym of 'Hysterical' is 'Funny'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.
